title: Easy Toddler Breakfast Rice Balls
summary: When you’re tired of making the same breakfast every morning, try these cheesy chicken & avocado rice balls! So easy to make, packed with protein and healthy fats, and perfect for little hands!
steps: Heat a little olive oil in a pan and cook the ground chicken with a sprinkle of garlic powder.
Push the chicken to one side and scramble an egg in the same pan.
Mix the chicken and egg together until fully cooked.
Add the mixture to your cooked white rice.
Mash in ¼ avocado, shredded cheese, and another sprinkle of garlic powder.
Mix everything together and form into little rice balls! And breakfast is served!
caption: Easy Toddler Breakfast Rice Balls 🍙🥑🍳 When you’re tired of making the same breakfast every morning, try these cheesy chicken & avocado rice balls! So easy to make, packed with protein and healthy fats, and perfect for little hands! 🤍 Ingredients: * 1 tbsp ground chicken * 1 egg * Cooked white rice (about ½ cup) * ¼ avocado * Shredded cheese * Garlic powder * Olive oil @Trader Joe's  Directions: 1. Heat a little olive oil in a pan and cook the ground chicken with a sprinkle of garlic powder. 2. Push the chicken to one side and scramble an egg in the same pan. 3. Mix the chicken and egg together until fully cooked. 4. Add the mixture to your cooked white rice. 5. Mash in ¼ avocado, shredded cheese, and another sprinkle of garlic powder. 6. Mix everything together and form into little rice balls! And breakfast is served! 🍙✨ Save this for your next toddler breakfast idea! 💛 #ToddlerMeals #ToddlerBreakfast #EasyToddlerMeals #easyrecipe
